additional_concerns: Both formulas rely on supplied exposure classifications; neither implements asset identification, aggregation, valuation or measurement timing. This limits end-to-end coverage without contradicting the threshold formula.

Footnote 7 situates the holistic discretionary assessment below 50% of NAV. The OR formulas preserve the classification outcome for known exposure values because the automatic route already applies at or above 50%; they do not implement the SFC's designation assessment.
The circular does not specify designation effective dates, persistence or withdrawal. An operative designation at the assessment time requires decision-specific evidence.
The three supplied external dependency IDs have no identifying metadata or source hashes. None can reliably be matched to a particular referenced authority.

UNKNOWN propagation and dependency-wide CONFLICT blocking are declared computational safeguards, not rules stated by the circular. In particular, conflict blocking can prevent a result even when another route would independently establish classification.

Neither formula introduces an unsupported numerical threshold or treats designation risk factors as an automatic designation. A false result remains limited to these circular routes and does not establish general non-complex status.
